five_winds.heading: Five winds — five archetypal patterns
five_winds.description: The five patterns are mirrors, not predictions. Each one describes a human situation and helps you frame what is already happening.

divine_tailwind.name: Divine Tailwind
divine_tailwind.description: The rare grace of full alignment. Everything you need is already moving toward you.

fair_sky.name: Fair Sky
fair_sky.description: Clear paths with gentle support. The way is open, but you must still walk it.

still_water.name: Still Water
still_water.description: The time for patience and stillness. Neither forward nor backward. Sit with what is.

crosswind.name: Crosswind
crosswind.description: Competing forces are pulling at you. This is not a cue to push harder. It's a cue to listen more carefully.

eye_of_storm.name: Eye of Storm
eye_of_storm.description: The deep stillness found at the center of a storm. When everything external is turbulent, clarity lives in the one place nothing can reach.

on_the_cards.heading: On the cards.
paragraphs: The five glyphs are not labels of fortune. They are not "good cards" or "bad cards."
Each one is a lens — a way of reading this particular moment, for this particular question, held by this particular person.
The same glyph can mean entirely different things on different days, for different people, about different questions.
What you receive is not a verdict. It is a perspective — and an invitation to look more carefully.

how_it_works.heading: How Glyph works.

step_1.title: Hold your question.
step_1.description: Compress it to 60 characters. The compression begins the answer.

step_2.title: Draw your pattern.
step_2.description: One of 100 archetypal forms, refined over a thousand years.

step_3.title: Read your reflection.
step_3.description: A short response — grounded in wisdom traditions and modern psychology.

rules: One question per reading. Don't ask many things at once.
Wait 48 hours before asking the same thing again. Answers need time to settle.
Compress your question into 60 characters. The compression is the beginning of the answer.
how_it_works.session_reminder: One question per session. If the same question calls you back, wait 48 hours.

final_cta.heading: Hold one question.
final_cta.subtitle: What you receive is not a verdict. It is an invitation to look more carefully.

hero.heading: Syncro
hero.subtitle: See your natural rhythms.
hero.description: Based on your birth context, Syncro reflects how the day's patterns align with you. Where to lean in. Where to slow down.
hero.tagline: A light rhythm map you can open anytime through your day.

what_shows.heading: What Syncro shows.
what_shows.intro: Open Syncro for a quick read on this stretch of your day — what's emphasized, and what to ease off.
items: A short description of the current pattern
What this period suits (for example, slow conversations)
What this period doesn't suit (for example, wait on big asks)

before_matters.title: Before something matters
before_matters.description: When you have a conversation, a decision, or a meeting ahead. A quick check-in before you step in.

pace_off.title: When the pace feels off
pace_off.description: When you're pushing but nothing's moving, or things feel frictionless but unfocused. A moment to recalibrate.

daily_rhythm.title: As a daily rhythm
daily_rhythm.description: Some people open Syncro the way others check the weather — a small ritual, a way to notice themselves.

traveling.title: When you're traveling
traveling.description: New environments, new timing. A way to stay grounded in your own rhythm wherever you are.

poju_companion.title: As a POJU companion
poju_companion.description: Use Syncro between POJU sessions to notice how your situation evolves between deeper conversations.
